name: Document - Processing Time Dashboard
description: Phân tích thời gian xử lý văn bản từ khi nhận đến khi đóng

cards.name: Thời gian xử lý trung bình (ngày)

native.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at))/86400)::numeric, 1) as avg_days FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_incoming WHERE status IN ('completed', 'processed', 'done') AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'

cards.name: Thời gian xử lý theo loại văn bản

native.query: SELECT 'incoming' as doc_type, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at))/86400)::numeric, 1) as avg_days FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_incoming WHERE status IN ('completed', 'processed', 'done') GROUP BY doc_type
SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at) as month, COUNT(*) as overdue FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_internal WHERE expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
